summary: Echo Fields is the drifting plain of memories, unrealized timelines, and fading echoes. It is the softest region of the Void, yet still dangerous as echoes distort reality.
history: Formed when the Void absorbed fragments of forgotten timelines.
Echoes drift across the plains, forming resonance pools.
Creatures born of memory and unreal timelines emerged.
The Echo Sovereign arose as the ruler of drifting echoes.
